Resolves #21891

Colors row 1 measured the dashboard before its first data load. In the failing hosted trace, the fallback label wrapped the toolbar during the drag, moving the dashboard's top edge by 7 px. The test now waits for the first rendered grid data cell before measuring its baseline. Both data sources reach that same readiness check.

Evidence: L3 local headless Chromium, three row-1 runs. This covers the automated gesture and geometry assertions.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical, one existing test readiness check.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| 1 | `ViewportController#updateWidgets` selects the source before writing the first rows. Row 1 waits for the existing data-cell locator before `readUnion` and any pointer input. |
| 2 | All three headless runs crossed the boundary, kept the popup and verified two source panes, the refill rectangle and chart text. |
